hook: HARD WORK ALONE|WILL NEVER|MAKE YOU RICH

voices.name: l00
voices.text: If hard work made you rich, <#0.2#> the people at the market before dawn would be the richest.
voices.caption: If hard work made you rich, the people at the market before dawn would be the richest.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: It's not that they don't work hard. <#0.3#> They work harder than anyone.
voices.caption: It's not that they don't work hard. They work harder than anyone.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Wealth isn't decided <#0.2#> by effort alone.
voices.caption: Wealth isn't decided by effort alone.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Money only fills <#0.2#> the vessel you have.
voices.caption: Money only fills the vessel you have.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Call lack a virtue, <#0.2#> refuse to receive, and the vessel stays blocked.
voices.caption: Call lack a virtue, refuse to receive, and the vessel stays blocked.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: As much as working hard, <#0.2#> you need to open your vessel.
voices.caption: As much as working hard, you need to open your vessel.
